Introduction
This document outlines the inspection 
steps I1 for the metal expansion joints, (zigzag
under the evaporator (HP & LP) & blows at the frame of the boiler and at GT 
stack,
Material: 15MO3), which must be carried out when 
the gas turbine have major maintenance after 4000 work hour.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdo 
Abdo El Hendawy, tested by eng. Ashraf Abdel Moniem Fahmy at 28 April 2002 on Boiler no. 4 and revised by 
EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, accepted by general director eng. 
Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demiatta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
HRSG out of service
Disconnect the power 
 supply of damper actuators and tagged it.
G T out of service and 
 (excitation CB & unit aux. CB & low voltage trans. CB) is rack out
Mack scaffolding at the 
 joint if need
All safety precaution 
 must be followed by safety department.
Tools and Equipment
Argon and 
 TIG welding machine
Grinder m/c & grinding discs
Filler metal for argon 
 and TIG welding.
Work to be Carried Out
Modify the zigzag under HP evaporator to bellows
Repair the deformations
Weld the cracks after grinding
